name: rail_thinning_volume
expr: ((rail_width - rail_wall)^2 - (rail_width - rail_end_wall)^2) * (2 * half_length - 2 * end_zone) - 2 * (1 - pi / 4) * rail_tool_radius^2 * (rail_width - rail_wall)

name: rail_mass
expr: (rail_area * 2 * half_length - rail_thinning_volume - rail_holes_volume - rail_breaks_volume) * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3

name: rebate_end_area
expr: (pi * rebate_tool_radius^2 - (rebate_tool_radius^2 * acos(rebate_end_offset / rebate_tool_radius) / 1 rad - rebate_end_offset * rebate_drop)) / 2

name: frame_taps_volume
expr: 4 * pi * tap_radius^2 * tap_depth + 20 * pi * m2_tap_radius^2 * tap_depth

name: frame_breaks_volume
expr: edge_break^2 / 2 * (4 * (2 * (rail_width - rail_end_wall - boss_radius) + (boss_radius - edge_break / 3) * pi / 2) + 2 * (4 * (rebate_centre_y - rebate_drop) + 4 * (rebate_centre_x - rebate_drop)))

name: frame_volume
expr: (4 * half_width * half_height - 4 * rebate_area - opening_area - wide_frame * side_opening_area) * frame_thickness + 4 * boss_area * standoff - 4 * pi * plunger_bore_radius^2 * plunger_bore_depth - frame_taps_volume - frame_breaks_volume

name: panels_mass
expr: (4 * (panel_half_x + panel_half_y) * panel_length * pcb_thickness - 4 * panel_holes_volume) * fr4_density * kg_per_m3

name: top_panel_mass
expr: (4 * panel_half_x * panel_half_y * pcb_thickness - panel_holes_volume) * fr4_density * kg_per_m3

name: leaf_area
expr: (leaf_outer - leaf_inner) * leaf_reach - (leaf_outer * sqrt(barrel_radius^2 - leaf_outer^2) + barrel_radius^2 * asin(leaf_outer / barrel_radius) / 1 rad - leaf_inner * sqrt(barrel_radius^2 - leaf_inner^2) - barrel_radius^2 * asin(leaf_inner / barrel_radius) / 1 rad) / 2

name: bracket_volume
expr: bracket_width * bracket_height * bracket_length + bracket_lip_volume - bracket_bore_volume - bracket_hole_volume - bracket_breaks_volume

name: bracket_moment
expr: (bracket_width * bracket_height * bracket_length - bracket_breaks_volume) * bracket_block_z + bracket_lip_volume * (panel_z_high + bracket_lip / 2) - bracket_bore_volume * hinge_z - bracket_hole_volume * panel_screw_z

name: wing_pcb_dz_y
expr: (wing_rect_y * (wing_top_z + wing_z_low) / 2 - wing_notches_y * (wing_top_z + notch_z) / 2 + wing_fillets * (notch_z + spandrel_centroid)) / wing_area_y - hinge_z

name: wing_pcb_dz_x
expr: (wing_rect_x * (wing_top_z + wing_z_low) / 2 - wing_notches_x * (wing_top_z + notch_z) / 2 + wing_fillets * (notch_z + spandrel_centroid)) / wing_area_x - hinge_z

name: hinge_parts_mass_y
expr: pi * pin_radius^2 * pin_length_y * steel_density * kg_per_m3 + 2 * bracket_volume * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3

name: hinge_parts_mass_x
expr: pi * pin_radius^2 * pin_length_x * steel_density * kg_per_m3 + 2 * bracket_volume * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3

name: hinge_parts_moment_y
expr: pi * pin_radius^2 * pin_length_y * steel_density * kg_per_m3 * hinge_z + 2 * bracket_moment * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3

name: hinge_parts_moment_x
expr: pi * pin_radius^2 * pin_length_x * steel_density * kg_per_m3 * hinge_z + 2 * bracket_moment * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3

name: wings_mass
expr: 2 * wings_y * (wing_pcb_mass_y + hinge_parts_mass_y + knuckle_mass_y) + 2 * wings_x * (wing_pcb_mass_x + hinge_parts_mass_x + knuckle_mass_x) + wing_cells * cic_mass

name: payload_z
expr: (payload_box_volume * (payload_bottom_z + payload_length / 2) + has_camera * lens_volume * (lens_front_z + lens_length / 2)) / (payload_box_volume + has_camera * lens_volume)

name: bus_mass
expr: 4 * rail_mass + 2 * frame_mass + panels_mass + top_panel_mass + (body_cells + top_cols) * cic_mass + wings_mass + avionics_boards * board_mass + battery_board_mass + battery_cells * cell_mass + rods_mass + spacers_mass + antenna_module_mass + 4 * plunger_mass + 16 * rail_screw_head_volume * steel_density * kg_per_m3

name: fixed_moment
expr: body_cells * cic_mass * body_cells_z + antenna_module_mass * antenna_z + board_mass * (avionics_boards * (top_board_z + board_centroid_dz) - board_pitch * avionics_boards * (avionics_boards - 1) / 2) + battery_board_mass * (battery_board_z + board_centroid_dz) + battery_cells * cell_mass * (cell_z + (cell_layers - 1) * cell_pitch / 2) + rods_mass * (frame_z0 + stack_bottom_z) / 2 + 4 * spacer_ring_area * aluminium_density * kg_per_m3 * (stack_head * (avionics_boards * (frame_z0 - stack_head / 2) - board_pitch * avionics_boards * (avionics_boards - 1) / 2) + battery_spacer_height * (lowest_board_z - battery_spacer_height / 2)) + 2 * wings_y * hinge_parts_moment_y + 2 * wings_x * hinge_parts_moment_x + top_panel_mass * top_panel_z + top_cols * cic_mass * top_cells_z

name: wings_moment_stowed
expr: 2 * wings_y * wing_pcb_mass_y * (hinge_z + wing_pcb_dz_y) + 2 * wings_x * wing_pcb_mass_x * (hinge_z + wing_pcb_dz_x) + wing_cells * cic_mass * (hinge_z + wing_cells_dz) + 2 * wings_y * knuckle_mass_y * (hinge_z + knuckle_dz) + 2 * wings_x * knuckle_mass_x * (hinge_z + knuckle_dz)

name: wings_moment
expr: 2 * wings_y * wing_pcb_mass_y * (hinge_z + wing_pcb_dz_y * cos(wing_angle)) + 2 * wings_x * wing_pcb_mass_x * (hinge_z + wing_pcb_dz_x * cos(wing_angle)) + wing_cells * cic_mass * (hinge_z + wing_cells_dy * sin(wing_angle) + wing_cells_dz * cos(wing_angle)) + (2 * wings_y * knuckle_mass_y + 2 * wings_x * knuckle_mass_x) * (hinge_z + knuckle_dy * sin(wing_angle) + knuckle_dz * cos(wing_angle))

name: plungers_moment
expr: 2 * plunger_mass * (-half_length - spring_drop + plunger_length / 2) + 2 * plunger_mass * (-half_length - switch_drop + plunger_length / 2)

name: payload_mass_max
expr: min(cds[form_factor].mass_limit - bus_mass_stowed - 0.001 kg, if(payload_z < -cg_limit_z, (bus_moment_stowed + cg_limit_z * bus_mass_stowed) / (-cg_limit_z - payload_z), 1000 kg))

name: payload_mass_min
expr: max(0.1 kg, if(payload_z < cg_limit_z, (bus_moment_stowed - cg_limit_z * bus_mass_stowed) / (cg_limit_z - payload_z), 0 kg))

name: total_moment_hand
expr: fixed_moment + wings_moment + plungers_moment + rbf_shown * rbf_mass * rbf_z + has_payload * payload_mass * payload_z

name: antenna_module_density
expr: (antenna_module_mass - element_mass) / ((antenna_module_side^2 - pi * antenna_hole_radius^2) * antenna_module_height - 4 * (pi * screw_clearance_radius^2 * antenna_module_height + countersink_volume)) / kg_per_m3

name: battery_max
expr: if(inner_length - has_payload * (payload_length + payload_gap) - board_pitch - stack_foot >= 3 * board_pitch, 3, 2)

name: boards_max
expr: floor((inner_length - has_payload * (payload_length + payload_gap) - stack_foot) / board_pitch) - battery_pitches

name: heaviest_payload
label: Heaviest payload the CDS mass and centre-of-gravity limits allow here

name: cg_x
label: Centre of gravity x, from the geometric centre (as shown)

name: cg_y
label: Centre of gravity y, from the geometric centre (as shown)

name: cg_z
label: Centre of gravity z, along the rails (as shown)

name: cg_z_stowed
label: Centre of gravity along the rails when stowed (hand sum)

name: cg_z_limit
label: CDS Table 2 limit along the rails (plus or minus)

name: antenna_length
label: Antenna element length, a quarter wave

name: antenna_wing_wavelengths
label: Antennas to the nearest deployed wing, in wavelengths (0 without wings)

name: wings_in_near_field
label: Wings inside the antennas' reactive near field, 0.16 wavelength (1: they detune the antenna; tune it with the wings out)

name: body_cell_count
label: Solar cells on the body, four sides and the +Z end (40 x 80 mm)

name: wing_boards

name: side_power

name: wing_power

form_factor
label: CubeSat size
description: The CubeSat form factor of the CubeSat Design Specification Rev. 14.1, Appendix B: 1U, 1.5U, 2U and 3U are 100 x 100 mm across the rails, 6U is 226.3 x 100 mm. Sets the rails, frames, panels, cells and the CDS mass and centre-of-gravity limits

name: deployment
label: Deployment, %
description: Drives the deployment: 0 is stowed in the dispenser (RBF pin in, switches and separation springs pressed flush). Above 0 the satellite is ejected: the springs and switches stand out, the wings swing out to 90 degrees between 10 and 50 %, the antennas unroll at the -Z end between 60 and 100 %

name: radio_frequency
label: Radio frequency, MHz
description: Downlink frequency of the deployable turnstile antenna at the -Z end (VHF or UHF). Each of its four tape elements is a quarter wave long. The outputs give how far the deployed wings are from the elements, in wavelengths, and flag wings inside the antenna's reactive near field

name: payload_kind
label: Payload
description: None, a closed instrument box, or a camera looking out through the -Z face and the antenna module. It sits on the bottom frame

name: payload_length
label: Payload length
description: Length of the payload along the rails. The longest is what the bay leaves beside the smallest stack (one board, a 2 or 4 cell battery)

name: payload_mass
label: Payload mass
description: Mass of the payload. The form allows up to what the CDS typical maximum mass (Table 1) and the centre-of-gravity limits (Table 2, stowed) leave beside the bus

name: avionics_boards
label: Avionics boards
description: PC/104 boards in the stack (OBC, EPS, radio, ADCS), stacked at 0.600 in under the top frame. As many as fit above the payload and the battery

name: battery_pack
label: Battery
description: 18650 Li-ion cells on a PC/104 battery board at the bottom of the stack: 2 or 4 cells in one layer, 8 in two layers (two layers only where the bay has room)

name: solar_wings
label: Solar wings
description: Deployable solar panels hinged at the +Z end, their cells to the sun with the +Z panel: none, two on the +Y and -Y faces, or four. Each carries the same cells as the face under it

title: CubeSat
description: A CubeSat structure and layout to the CubeSat Design Specification Rev. 14.1 (Cal Poly): pick 1U to 6U, the payload, the PC/104 stack, the battery, the radio frequency and the solar wings, and drag the deployment from stowed in the dispenser to open in orbit. Four hard-anodised rails screwed to two end frames with standoff bosses, body, +Z and deployable solar panels, the wings on pinned hinges, and a turnstile antenna a quarter wave long at the -Z end, beside the camera, away from the wings. Assertions check the CDS rail envelope, rail width and edges, the 6.5 mm protrusion zone, standoffs, mass and centre-of-gravity limits, the fasteners and hinges, and prove the mass budget and centre of gravity against a hand sum of every part. Export: the machined parts for CNC milling with file.export to a .step file with bodies ["Rail (+X, +Y)", "Rail (-X, +Y)", "Top frame", "Bottom frame", "Hinge brackets +Y", "RBF pin"] at Deployment 0 (two rails of each hand, one top and one bottom frame, two brackets per wing, one RBF pin; in the window select the named set Machined parts and export the selection); the solar panel PCB outlines with file.export to .dxf with the set "Panel PCB outlines".
